We have had an ongoing medical issue for the last 15 months. This has been hugely exasperated by constant delays, misdiagnosis and the complete inability to physically assess a child.

We have ended up in a&e, out of hours doctors and on one occasion an ambulance because of the lack of knowledge and care from this surgery.

We have done exactly as we’re told followed all the rules not made a fuss and just hoped things would improve.

We have repeatedly missed out on same day appointments due to staff including those in charge being really late for work - this has been communicated to us by the receptionists who have to handle the complaints.

After over a year of this and the delays meaning much worse symptoms,  I went into the surgery in person and they made time to see me. I thought a resolution would be met instead I was met with someone who would verbally discuss my complaint but despite making time for the meeting refused to clinically assess my poorly infant just out of principal so we sat in the room discussing for 15 minutes. This is a practicing doctor who would rather run the clock on a complaint appointment that just do the doctors appointment promised.
